full_judgment:
Syed Refaat Ahmed, J: In this application under section 115(1) of the Code of Civil Procedure a Rule was issued calling upon the party to show cause as to why the judgment and decree of reversal dated 14.2.2001 passed by the Additional District and Sessions Judge, Dhaka in Title Appeal No. 229 of 1994 should not be set aside and or pass such other further order or orders as to this court may seem fit and proper. 

 5. The petitioner No.1 Bank now submits that the lower appellate court erred in law in reversing the judgment and decree of the trial court without discussing and considering the material findings of the Trial court properly. Consequently, the impugned judgment is said to be devoid of cogent reasons justifying reversal and is therefore not to be considered as a proper judgment of reversal. It is submitted further that the lower Appellate court erred in law in failing to consider that the order of termination is on the face of it a termination simpliciter, without any aspersion or stigma attaching to the opposite party and as such, the suit is not sustainable in law. In that regard it is also submitted that the relation between the Bank and the opposite party being one of master and servant the lower Appellate court erred in not holding that the suit is not sustainable in law.
